authority.providerStatus: context only; provider failure must not automatically change unrelated source health
authority.origin: Canonical Source Registry V2 projection rules

rules: UNKNOWN is a valid fail-closed observation state and must not be rewritten to HEALTHY without evidence
unsupported capability is not evidence of broken source health
provider-level HELD or failure is context only unless per-source evidence identifies the source
candidate failure must not replace last-known-good
timestamps must not be invented; unavailable observed times are null
unmatched external source-status identities are reported, never silently remapped
health projection is observational and must not mutate Farm state, source identity, LKG, lifecycle authority, or release state
precedence: Farm runtimeHealth when it is a recognized non-UNKNOWN health state
